name: Chickens and cows
notes: Only for the first few levels. Move on as soon as you can survive crabs.

name: Sand crabs

notes: Food for the first few levels
They reset if you step away, so you get a lot of experience for very little attention. Rates depend on your gear more than your level.

name: Ammonite crabs
notes: More hitpoints than sand crabs, so fewer respawns to reset.

name: Nightmare Zone

notes: Five qualifying quests to unlock enough bosses
Absorption potions make this close to idle, but they cost real money and have to be bought.

name: Slayer tasks
notes: Slower than dedicated training, but it pays for itself many times over and levels Slayer at the same time.

name: Hill giants
notes: A free-to-play staple. The big bones pay for Prayer levels later.

name: Hill giants
notes: A free-to-play staple. The big bones pay for Prayer levels later.

name: Any combat training
notes: Hitpoints comes along with everything else you kill, at roughly a third the rate of the combat skill you are training.

name: Nightmare Zone on controlled
notes: Controlled attack style spreads experience across all three melee skills while Hitpoints ticks up regardless.

name: Chickens
notes: Collect the feathers; they pay for your arrows.

name: Sand crabs
notes: Bring an Ava's device so you keep your ammunition.

name: Chinchompas at Maniacal monkeys
notes: The fastest ranged experience in the game, and priced to match. Budget before you commit.

name: Nightmare Zone
notes: A cheaper alternative to chinchompas that asks almost nothing of you.

name: Slayer tasks with a cannon

notes: Dwarf Cannon for the cannon
Turns slow tasks into fast ones and keeps the drops coming.

name: Bury big bones
notes: Cheap and slow. Fine early, but an altar is worth switching to quickly.

name: Dragon bones on a gilded altar

notes: A player-owned house with a gilded altar, or use someone else's
The standard way to buy Prayer levels. Expensive per hour but very fast, so the total cost to 70 is what matters, not the rate.

name: Ensouled heads
notes: Needs Arceuus spellbook runes rather than bones, which suits an account that has more runes than gold.

name: Chaos altar in the Wilderness
notes: Half your bones are not consumed, so the cost per level roughly halves — but you are in the Wilderness, and people do come for you.

name: Curse spells on splashers
notes: Cast a curse with no damage bonus so you never kill the target.

name: Splashing
notes: Deliberately wear negative magic accuracy so every cast misses. Nearly zero attention, and priced entirely in runes.

name: High Level Alchemy
notes: Rate is fixed by the spell, not your level. Pick an item that alchs for more than the nature rune costs and this is free experience.

name: Stun-alching
notes: Alternate Stun with High Alchemy. Roughly double the alching rate, and it asks for your full attention.

name: Trident on Slayer tasks
notes: Slower than alching but it pays you and levels Slayer at the same time.

name: Cook shrimp and sardines
notes: Catch them yourself and this costs nothing.

name: Cook trout and salmon
notes: Whatever you caught while training Fishing.

name: Cook karambwan

notes: Tai Bwo Wannai Trio to cook them

location: Any range with a bank nearby
notes: Cooked one at a time rather than as a batch, so it is fast but constant clicking. The fish are cheap.

name: Make jugs of wine
notes: The fastest cooking experience there is, and it needs no range at all.

name: Chop regular trees
notes: Drop the logs. Oaks are better from 15.

name: Chop oak logs
notes: Oaks do not deplete, so you can settle in on one tree.

name: Chop willow logs
notes: The classic low-effort option, and the bank is right there.

name: Chop teak trees
notes: Fast and profitable if you tick-manipulate; still good if you do not.

name: Chop sulliusceps
notes: Good experience, good money, and no banking.

name: Chop redwood logs
notes: Slower than teaks but almost completely idle, and it pays well.

name: Cut arrow shafts
notes: A few minutes of work to get past the first levels.

name: String unstrung bows
notes: Buy unstrung bows and bowstring, string them, sell them back. Often turns a small profit.

name: Make darts
notes: By far the fastest fletching experience, and by far the most expensive. Instant on click, so it is pure clicking speed.

name: Tip broad bolts
notes: Cheaper than darts and still quick. Uses Slayer points for the tips.

name: Net shrimp and anchovies
notes: Just the first twenty levels.

name: Fly fish trout and salmon
notes: Drop the fish for speed, or cook them for Cooking levels on the side.

name: Barbarian fishing
notes: Gives Agility and Strength experience alongside the Fishing, which is most of the reason to do it.

name: Fish karambwan

notes: Tai Bwo Wannai Trio
Three-tick fishing makes this fast, but it needs constant precise clicking.

name: Fish anglerfish

notes: 100% Piscarilius favour
Slow experience, but anglerfish sell well and it asks nothing of you.

name: Burn logs on a line
location: Grand Exchange or Varrock west bank
notes: Buy the logs, walk a line burning them, repeat.

name: Wintertodt
notes: The default answer for Firemaking: good experience, useful supplies as rewards, and no log cost at all.

name: Burn magic logs
notes: Faster than Wintertodt and needs no minigame, but you are burning close to a million gold an hour to do it.

name: Craft leather gloves and boots
notes: Cheap way past the opening levels.

name: Cut gems
notes: Sapphires, then emeralds, then rubies and diamonds as you level.

name: Craft dragonhide bodies
notes: The standard route to 99. Costly, but it is the fastest sustained rate.

name: Blow glass
notes: Much cheaper than dragonhide, at roughly half the rate.

name: Smith bronze and iron
notes: Just to get moving.

name: Smelt cannonballs

notes: Dwarf Cannon for the ammo mould
Very slow experience, but it makes money and you can leave it alone for long stretches.

name: Blast Furnace
notes: The fastest smithing by a wide margin, and it needs your full attention.

name: Smelt gold bars with goldsmith gauntlets

notes: Family Crest for the goldsmith gauntlets
The single fastest smithing experience in the game.

name: Mine copper and tin
location: Lumbridge Swamp or the Al Kharid mine
notes: Only until iron opens up at 15.

name: Power-mine iron ore

notes: A three-rock cluster for the best rates

location: Ardougne east mine or the Al Kharid quarry
notes: Drop the ore as you go. Banking it instead is slower but profitable.

name: Motherlode Mine

notes: 72 Mining for the upper level
Slower than iron, but it pays for itself in nuggets and ore and needs little attention.

name: Mine volcanic ash
notes: Better experience than the Motherlode Mine and it still makes money.

name: Mine amethyst
notes: Slow, but very idle and it pays well.

name: Make attack potions
notes: Cheap, and gets you to the potions worth making.

name: Make prayer potions
notes: Usually profitable, which makes it the rare Herblore method that pays you.

name: Make super restores
notes: Steady experience and you will use the potions yourself.

name: Make Saradomin brews
notes: The fastest sustained Herblore rate.

name: Gnome Stronghold course
notes: Slow, but there is nothing better this early.

name: Draynor Village rooftops
notes: Rooftop courses also drop marks of grace, which buy the graceful outfit.

name: Seers' Village rooftops
notes: The usual mid-game course. A camelot teleport tab resets you to the start.

name: Ardougne rooftops
notes: The last and fastest rooftop course.

name: Hallowed Sepulchre
notes: Faster than rooftops from the mid-70s and it pays properly, but it is a precision course rather than a click-and-wait one.

name: Pickpocket men and women
notes: Four levels and you are done with this.

name: Steal from the cake stall
notes: Also feeds you, which matters when you have no food.

name: Pickpocket Ardougne knights

notes: Ardougne Diary for the extra pickpocket chance
The mainstay of Thieving training: fast experience and real money, at the cost of constant clicking and dodging stuns.

name: Pickpocket master farmers
notes: The seeds are worth more than the experience early on.

name: Pickpocket vyres
notes: The fastest Thieving in the game once you can reach it.

name: Turael tasks
notes: Low-level tasks with no requirements. Also used later to reset a task you do not want.

name: Chaeldar tasks

notes: 70 combat
A good balance of task length and points once you can handle them.

name: Nieve or Steve tasks

notes: 85 combat
Longer tasks and better drops. The standard mid-to-late Slayer master.

name: Duradel tasks

notes: 100 combat
Shilo Village
The fastest Slayer experience and the best drop table, if your combat stats can keep up.

name: Tree and fruit tree runs
notes: Not an hourly activity: ten minutes of planting every few hours. Measured per hour spent, nothing else in the game comes close.

name: Herb runs
notes: Five minutes of work every eighty minutes, and it funds your Herblore.

name: Allotment patches
notes: Something to do alongside the early tree runs.

name: Tithe Farm
notes: Continuous Farming experience rather than run-based, and the points buy the farmer's outfit.

name: Craft air runes
notes: Slow, but the alternative is slower.

name: Craft lava runes

notes: A binding necklace, and the Karamja gloves help
Fast for its level, and it makes money. Uses pouches heavily.

name: Guardians of the Rift

notes: Temple of the Eye
Comparable experience to lava runes with far less running, and the rewards include the colossal pouch and the raiments outfit.

name: Craft blood runes
notes: Modest experience, but among the best steady money in the game.

name: Bird snaring
notes: Lay several snares at once and work the circuit.

name: Catch chinchompas
notes: Good experience and very good money, but you are laying and resetting traps constantly.

name: Birdhouse runs
notes: Two minutes of work every fifty. Like tree runs, it is not really an hourly activity.

name: Herbiboar
notes: Fast, profitable in herbs, and no traps to reset.

name: Build and remove oak larders

notes: A house with a kitchen, and a butler
Construction is bought, not earned. The only question is which plank you can afford.

name: Build oak dungeon doors

notes: A dungeon in your house, and a demon butler
The best experience per plank, and the fastest route to 99.

name: Build mahogany tables

notes: A demon butler to fetch the planks
The fastest Construction there is, and the most expensive thing in this plugin by some distance.

name: Make your own planks first
notes: For an ironman, the sawmill run is the real cost of Construction, not the building.
